notes.title: Weapon Case Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

With this update, the first weapon of the battleship is reworked to fit the battleship theme better!

There are also other small changes that improve the overall gameplay feel.

Changelog for 1.0.4

Pistol Rework

Murk45 Cannon: The pistol is now changed into a cannon weapon that shoots heavy projectiles that pierce through enemies. The cannon starts with +1 pierce, you can increase this amount with upgrade cards.

Bow and Arrow

Bow and Arrow now starts with +1 bounce. The arrow speed and the bounce detection range are also increased to make the arrow feel snappier.

Upgrade Cards

Uncommon and rare varieties are added for the HP and Armor upgrades.

UI

Upgrade cards are now more responsive when you hover your mouse over them.
[hr][/hr]
– Oğuzcan

notes.title: Weapon Case Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Time for another update, and this one brings three brand-new weapons to the game!

This patch focuses on adding more variety through new totems, making the final boss encounter feel more epic, and improving overall gameplay flow and movement. Thanks again for all the feedback, it helps shape the direction of the game  

Changelog for 1.0.3

New Weapons

Ice Totem Fires icy projectiles around the player in all directions.

Poison Totem Leaves behind gas clouds that deal a percentage of the enemies' max health as damage. Great for crowd control and tougher enemies.

Fire Totem (Reworked) The old flame circle has been fully reworked into a proper totem. It now has a new name, a new icon, and appears visually on the player when acquired through an upgrade card.

Level Completion Overhaul

The level completion system has been reworked. Previously, surviving for 20 minutes would complete the level regardless of the boss being alive or defeated. Now, when the timer hits 0, a level-end boss spawns and you must defeat it to complete the level.

The final boss now has new attack patterns and its own theme music, making the final fight much more intense and memorable.

Movement Balance

Both the Raft and the Battleship now move 20 to 30 percent faster. Movement should feel more responsive and smoother overall.

Next Up

For the next update, I’ll be focusing on expanding the upgrade system for existing weapons. More ways to scale your build and customize your run are coming soon.
[hr][/hr]
As always, thanks for playing and for being part of this journey!

– Oğuzcan

notes.title: Weapon Case Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changelog for 1.0.2

Upgrade System Improvements

Improved early game weapon upgrade offers: You’re now more likely to receive weapon upgrades early on, making it easier to build up your arsenal and keep pace with enemy difficulty.

Weapon upgrade icon added: Weapon upgrade cards now feature a distinct icon in the top-left corner, helping you spot them easily and avoid accidentally skipping them.

Audio Settings

Master volume setting added: You can now adjust the overall volume from the settings menu.

Fixed audio muting bug: Previously, pulling the volume slider down didn’t completely mute the sound; that issue is now resolved.
[hr][/hr]
As always, thanks for playing and for being part of this journey!

– Oğuzcan

notes.title: Weapon Case Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
As a solo developer, I’ve been working diligently to implement improvements based on your feedback. This update focuses on making the early game more balanced and improving the overall experience, while laying the groundwork for future features.

More updates are coming soon, and your support means the world. ❤️

Changelog for 1.0.1

Gameplay & Balance

Adjusted difficulty curve: The early game is now a bit more forgiving. Enemy waves and bosses should feel more manageable, especially in the first few minutes.

Battleship unlocked by default: I’ve removed the old currency system so that everyone can use the Battleship right away, it’s just more fun that way! I'm planning a much deeper meta progression system for a future update.

Fixes & Improvements

Fixed difficulty selection bug: The game now correctly starts with your chosen difficulty.

Added Quit Game option: You can now exit the game from the main menu without needing to Alt+F4.

I know the random upgrade system can be frustrating at times, especially when you go a while without getting a weapon upgrade early on. It’s something I’ve noticed too, and I’m already working on ways to make that experience feel better and more fair without losing the fun of randomness.

Thanks again for playing! If you're enjoying the game (or have more feedback), please consider leaving a review; it helps!

– Oğuzcan
